prefix_hash_semantics: SHA-256 over the final checkpoint-projected scene prefix after casting scene tokens and persisted boundaries to bfloat16; consult runtime_validation.runtime_prefix_parity_validated before treating it as a model-validated chat-runtime prefix
purpose: Counterfactual signal audit from numeric maps through frozen-LM behavior

summary_findings.diagnosis: The counterfactual signal is present in raw and aggregated maps and remains visible in spatial block tokens. The dominant loss occurs in the global Perceiver resampler: its 256 native latents are almost duplicate vectors, and scene-pair relative L2 falls by roughly two to three further orders of magnitude before LM projection. Distinct SHA-256 hashes therefore certify only bitwise inequality, not a behaviorally useful separation.
summary_findings.recommended_fix: Preserve spatially anchored latent diversity (for example, regional latent banks followed by global mixing), add an explicit counterfactual scene-token separation/diversity objective, and keep the projected scene signal in float32 until a learned gain produces differences safely above the bfloat16 quantization floor. Re-evaluate changed-question generation after each intervention.
